learned: Cloudflare Pages requires index.html at the root to serve the site root; atob() returns binary strings not UTF-8, requiring TextDecoder for any non-ASCII content from the GitHub API.
session_note: Founding session. Replaced a localStorage/drag-drop prototype with a live GitHub fetch architecture. The projects.json config pattern (one JSON line to add a project) was a key design decision that keeps the HTML focused on rendering.

completed: Expandable cards with inline backlog reveal, ORDOBook encoding fixed, all 5 cards rendering cleanly.
learned: CSS grid-template-rows: 0fr → 1fr is the correct pattern for smooth expand animations on unknown-height content — no max-height hacks, no JS measurement needed.

learned: iOS auto-zoom on input focus is triggered by font-size below 16px — setting inputs to 16px on mobile prevents it without disabling user zoom. CSS viewport maximum-scale=1 stops layout-breaking zoom on orientation change.
session_note: Chad used the Notepad export flow in the same session it was built and immediately filed 3 real bugs with it. The Copy as prompt idea came from that first use. Notepad → export → Claude Code is the intended power loop.

completed: Dashboard backburner — cards auto-sort by updated date, top 4 featured, rest collapsed behind a carrot. Added garden-app as 7th project. Shipped favicon and apple-touch-icon in sage-deep green.
learned: PNG files can be generated from pure Python with only stdlib (struct + zlib) — no PIL needed for simple shapes. iOS apple-touch-icon requires a real PNG (SVG not supported) but browser favicons accept SVG directly via <link rel='icon' type='image/svg+xml'>.
session_note: First use of collapsible sub-sections inside the main grid. The backburner pattern (default-closed, localStorage-persisted open state) keeps the default view clean while preserving intentional exploration. garden-app is the first project registered that will NOT have a Cloudflare deployment — it's a standalone SwiftUI/iOS app, a new learning vector for Chad.

completed: Notes sync resilience: initSync now detects local-only notes (created while offline or not yet pushed) and auto-pushes them on reconnect. Sync indicator now shows live note count for at-a-glance reassurance.
learned: Offline-first sync has two failure modes worth distinguishing: silent failed pushes (red-dot visible, user can retry) and orphan writes (note exists locally but never made it to the remote). The orphan case is the dangerous one — it looks synced because there's nothing to retry. Detecting it requires comparing local IDs against remote IDs on every init, not just tracking push failures.
session_note: Verified notes persistence by pulling the live /api/gist endpoint — found all notes intact plus 3 commits of gist version history (GitHub retains every prior state of the gist indefinitely, so even corruption is undoable). Confirmed Gist backend is fine to keep long-term with a no-expiration token; KV migration deferred as unnecessary.
